meta.title: About us
meta.description: Who we are, why compassion for animals can be learnt, and how Friends of Animals works.

hero.title: Kindness to animals is something children can learn
hero.lead: Friends of Animals (FOA) is an Indian non-profit. We help children and young adults practise compassion for animals through art, writing, photography and film.
hero.easy: We help children learn to be kind to animals, by making art about them.

duty.title: It is in our Constitution
duty.body: Article 51A(g) lists compassion for living creatures among the duties of every Indian citizen. It is a duty and a value, something each of us can practise every day.
duty.court: In 2014 the Supreme Court said what that compassion means:

vision.vision: To build a world where compassion for animals is a universal human value, inspiring people to treat all animals with respect, kindness, and care.
vision.mission: To nurture compassion for animals as a lifelong human value, especially among children and young adults, through awareness, education, creative engagement, community participation, and positive action.

skill.title: Compassion grows with practice
skill.easy: Kindness gets stronger when you practise it, just like drawing.
skill.body: To draw a crow well, you have to watch it: how it tilts its head, where it waits, what it needs. Looking that closely turns an animal from background into a neighbour. A competition gives children a reason to look, a deadline to finish, and recognition when they do. We hope the habit lasts long after the certificate is framed.
skill.detail: Indian education policy already asks for this. NEP 2020 names “compassion and empathy” among the aims of education, and the foundational-stage curriculum (NCF-FS 2022) lists kindness to animals as a learning outcome. FOA gives schools a creative way to work on both.

ashoka.title: Care for animals, carved in stone
ashoka.body: In the 3rd century BCE, Emperor Ashoka had his edicts cut into rock across his empire. One of them, at Girnar in Gujarat, records medical care for animals as well as for people.

how.title: From a child’s drawing to a kinder street

create.title: Children create
create.body: Drawing, painting, art, craft, essays, photography and films, all about animals and how to treat them well.

share.title: The public sees
share.body: Selected work goes into a public gallery and awareness campaigns, with the young artist’s name shown safely.

grow.title: Compassion spreads
grow.body: Families, schools and neighbours meet animals through children’s eyes. More people treat animals with respect, kindness and care.

people.title: The people who make FOA work
people.lead: FOA brings together the people who teach children and the people who look after animals.

items.participants: Young people who enter on their own

shelter.title: We are not a shelter
shelter.lead: FOA does not house animals. Later, we plan to connect families who want to adopt with the people who already care for animals, and to build a network of them across India.

badges.title: Badges, not a ladder
badges.lead: After a competition, the friendship with FOA can continue. Each badge marks something you did. Earn them in any order, or just one.
badges.note: There are no streaks, points or rankings. Badges show on your own dashboard, and we never put a child’s badges on a public page.

participant.name: Participant
participant.earn: Your place in any FOA competition is confirmed.

schoolWinner.name: School Winner
schoolWinner.earn: Your school’s judges award you a school merit certificate.

finalist.name: FOA Finalist
finalist.earn: Your work reaches FOA’s final round and is named a winner, runner-up, finalist or special mention.

volunteer.name: Volunteer
volunteer.earn: FOA approves your application to volunteer.

ambassador.name: Ambassador
ambassador.earn: FOA appoints you as an ambassador.

objectives.title: What we are working on now

items.title: Build and launch the platform
items.body: One place where young people register, enter competitions, send their work and get their certificates.

items.title: Run pilot competitions
items.body: Drawing, painting, art, craft, essay, photography and videography, all about animals and their well-being.

items.title: Work with schools and colleges
items.body: Partner with selected institutions to reach children and young adults.

items.title: Build the first community
items.body: Help one-time entrants stay connected to animals and to each other.

items.title: Start an animal-welfare network
items.body: A structured list of volunteers, welfare organisations and others who help animals.

items.title: Spread awareness on social media
items.body: Educational and creative posts, including work by participants.

items.title: Grow the volunteer network
items.body: Students and young volunteers in technology, content, outreach and running competitions.

items.title: Measure and learn
items.body: Track what works before we grow.

transparency.title: Our accounts will be public
transparency.body: FOA has decided to make its financial information public. When donations begin, we will publish what came in and where it went, so anyone can check.

about.name: Friends of Animals (FOA) is an Indian non-profit. We are not connected with other organisations that use the same name, in India or abroad.
